title: IN THE DIALS
THE GODS ARE DEAD
Let Us Be Drunk
WHEN YOU ARE OLD

WHAT IS TO COME
Echoes 1 — CHIMING a dream by the way
Echoes 2 — LIFE is bitter.  All the faces of the years
Echoes 3 — O, GATHER me the rose, the rose
Echoes 4 — OUT of the night that covers me
Echoes 5 — I AM the Reaper
Echoes 6 — PRAISE the generous gods for giving
Echoes 7 — FILL a glass with golden wine
Echoes 8 — WE’LL go no more a-roving by the light of the moon
Echoes 9 — MADAM Life’s a piece in bloom
Echoes 10 — THE sea is full of wandering foam
Echoes 11 — THICK is the darkness—
Echoes 12 — TO me at my fifth-floor window
Echoes 13 — BRING her again, O western wind
Echoes 14 — THE wan sun westers, faint and slow
Echoes 15 — THERE is a wheel inside my head
Echoes 16 — WHILE the west is paling
Echoes 17 — THE sands are alive with sunshine
Echoes 18 — THE nightingale has a lyre of gold
Echoes 19 — YOUR heart has trembled to my tongue
Echoes 20 — THE surges gushed and sounded
Echoes 21 — WE flash across the level
Echoes 22 — THE West a glimmering lake of light
Echoes 23 — THE skies are strown with stars
Echoes 24 — THE full sea rolls and thunders
Echoes 25 — IN the year that’s come and gone, love, his flying feather
Echoes 26 — IN the placid summer midnight
Echoes 27 — SHE sauntered by the swinging seas
Echoes 28 — BLITHE dreams arise to greet us
Echoes 29 — A CHILD
Echoes 30 — KATE-A-WHIMSIES, John-a-Dreams
Echoes 31 — O, HAVE you blessed, behind the stars
Echoes 32 — O, FALMOUTH is a fine town with ships in the bay
Echoes 33 — THE ways are green with the gladdening sheen
Echoes 34 — Love blows as the wind blows
Echoes 35 — A LATE lark twitters from the quiet skies
Echoes 36 — I GAVE my heart to a woman—
Echoes 37 — OR ever the knightly years were gone
Echoes 38 — ON the way to Kew
Echoes 39 — THE Past was goodly once, and yet, when all is said
Echoes 40 — THE spring, my dear
Echoes 41 — The Spirit of Wine
Echoes 42 — A WINK from Hesper, falling
Echoes 43 — FRIENDS . . . old friends . .
Echoes 44 — IF it should come to be
Echoes 45 — FROM the brake the Nightingale
Echoes 46 — IN the waste hour
Echoes 47 — CROSSES and troubles a-many have proved me
